description: NaSr₃Be₃B₃O₉F₄ crystallizes in the trigonal R3m space group. Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four F atoms. There are three shorter (2.25 Å) and one longer (2.42 Å) Na-F bond length. Sr is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to six O and three equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.69-3.05 Å. There is one shorter (2.46 Å) and two longer (2.56 Å) Sr-F bond lengths. Be is bonded to three O and one F atom to form corner-sharing BeO₃F tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.59 Å) and two longer (1.60 Å) Be-O bond lengths. The Be-F bond length is 1.70 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.38 Å) and one longer (1.40 Å) B-O bond length. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Sr, one Be, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Sr, one Be, and one B atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to one Na and three equivalent Sr atoms to form distorted FNaSr₃ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent FNaSr₃ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one FNaBe₃ trigonal pyramid, and edges with two equivalent FNaSr₃ tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to one Na and three equivalent Be atoms to form distorted corner-sharing FNaBe₃ trigonal pyramids.
